svg.title: $850,000 Gross Sales to $157,250 Owner Net
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-owner-profit-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: $850,000 Gross Sales to $157,250 Owner Net; subtitle: Six bars reconcile exactly to the Base-Case 18.5% net margin; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD per mature operating year. The first bar opens the balance, the next four bars are signed deductions, and the sixth bar is the closing total rather than another additive movement. Cost allocations are illustrative; gross revenue, margin, and owner net match the supplied scorecard. Owner net is the modeled business residual before personal income tax; no separate owner salary is deducted in this illustration.; caption: $850,000 − $510,000 − $42,500 − $55,250 − $85,000 = $157,250; $157,250 ÷ $850,000 = 18.5%. Acquisition cost is an expense in this bridge, not an amount omitted from revenue.; stages: label: Gross parcel sales; value: $850,000 opening balance; numeric value: 850000.0; detail: Recognize the model's gross completed parcel sale proceeds: 17 exits averaging $50,000. This principal trading model does not substitute broker commissions or third-party transaction volume for operator revenue.; label: Parcel acquisition basis; value: −$510,000; 60.0% of sales; numeric value: -510000.0; detail: Allocate $30,000 average purchase price to each of 17 sold parcels. Match inventory basis to completed sales; cash spent on parcels still held at year-end is not automatically a current-year sale expense.; label: Diligence and preparation; value: −$42,500; 5.0% of sales; numeric value: -42500.0; detail: Allow $2,500 per sold parcel for survey work, environmental screening, zoning verification, and limited site preparation. Specialist investigations or major entitlements require a separate acquisition budget.; label: Closing and selling; value: −$55,250; 6.5% of sales; numeric value: -55250.0; detail: Allow $3,250 per sold parcel for allocated acquisition and disposition settlement charges, title costs, transaction-linked marketing, and applicable brokerage. Exclude these items from overhead to prevent double counting.; label: Carry and operating expense; value: −$85,000; 10.0% of sales; numeric value: -85000.0; detail: Combine $25,000 annual parcel carry and financing expense with $60,000 recurring operating expense. The latter equals $5,000 monthly for contract capacity, screening systems, outreach, and administration.; label: Annual owner net; value: $157,250 closing total; numeric value: 157250.0; detail: The final residual is 18.5% of gross sales after all four modeled expense groups. Render this bar from zero as the ending total, not as an additional increase to the running balance.

circle.title: label: Gross parcel sales; value: $850,000 opening balance; numeric value: 850000.0; detail: Recognize the model's gross completed parcel sale proceeds: 17 exits averaging $50,000. This principal trading model does not substitute broker commissions or third-party transaction volume for operator revenue.

label: Parcel acquisition basis; value: −$510,000; 60.0% of sales; numeric value: -510000.0; detail: Allocate $30,000 average purchase price to each of 17 sold parcels. Match inventory basis to completed sales; cash spent on parcels still held at year-end is not automatically a current-year sale expense.

label: Diligence and preparation; value: −$42,500; 5.0% of sales; numeric value: -42500.0; detail: Allow $2,500 per sold parcel for survey work, environmental screening, zoning verification, and limited site preparation. Specialist investigations or major entitlements require a separate acquisition budget.

label: Closing and selling; value: −$55,250; 6.5% of sales; numeric value: -55250.0; detail: Allow $3,250 per sold parcel for allocated acquisition and disposition settlement charges, title costs, transaction-linked marketing, and applicable brokerage. Exclude these items from overhead to prevent double counting.

label: Carry and operating expense; value: −$85,000; 10.0% of sales; numeric value: -85000.0; detail: Combine $25,000 annual parcel carry and financing expense with $60,000 recurring operating expense. The latter equals $5,000 monthly for contract capacity, screening systems, outreach, and administration.

label: Annual owner net; value: $157,250 closing total; numeric value: 157250.0; detail: The final residual is 18.5% of gross sales after all four modeled expense groups. Render this bar from zero as the ending total, not as an additional increase to the running balance.

text.title: Assumptions: USD per mature operating year. The first bar opens the balance, the next four bars are signed deductions, and the sixth bar is the closing total rather than another additive movement. Cost allocations are illustrative; gross revenue, margin, and owner net match the supplied scorecard. Owner net is the modeled business residual before personal income tax; no separate owner salary is deducted in this illustration.
